item.title: Remembering the cultural icons of South Africa: A tribute to those we lost in 2025
item.description: As the curtain falls on 2025, South Africa finds itself in a state of collective mourning, reflecting on a year that has seen the untimely passing of several beloved figures from the media and entertainment industry.

item.title: Stormers lose two key backs as Lions circle ahead of Cape Town URC derby
item.description: Stormers flyhalf Jurie Matthee (middle) must fill the boots of the injured Springboks star Sacha Feinberg-Mngomezulu, while Wandisile Simelane (left) will step in for outside centre Ruhan Nel when the Cape side face the Lions on Saturday in the United Rugby Championship.

item.title: South African celebrities reflect on family, traditions, and new beginnings this festive season
item.description: South African celebrities open up about their heartfelt Christmas traditions and their hopes for a successful New Year.

item.title: Shades of 2007 Super Rugby final as Sharks and Bulls lock horns once more
item.description: Bulls forward Jan-Hendrik Wessels will look to make an impact off the bench as he returns from a nine-week suspension when they face the Sharks on Saturday in Durban.

item.title: Exploring the complexities of South Africa's 2025 commissions of inquiry
item.description: A dedicated judicial commission, chaired by a retired justice, at least promises a systematic airing of who decided what, when, across several administrations.

item.title: Corruption and Chaos: The year South Africa's health system crumbled
item.description: In 2025, South Africa's public healthcare system faced an unprecedented crisis, grappling with severe staff shortages, rampant corruption, and alarming surgical delays, putting countless lives at risk and igniting nationwide protests for change.

item.title: Experience the Magic of Durban Underground this Christmas
item.description: With nearly three decades of tradition, the Durban Underground event has blossomed from its humble origins as a casual house party into a premier gathering that draws both Durbanites and tourists alike, all ready to embrace the joyous spirit of the holiday.
